results.name: Homepage loads with hero and navigation
results.expected: Hero heading and nav render
results.actual: Hero and navigation rendered correctly

results.name: Property listing page returns database results
results.expected: Cards render and count matches API total
results.actual: 7 property cards rendered; page reports 7 properties found

results.name: Property detail page opens from a listing card
results.expected: Detail page shows title, price and enquiry actions
results.actual: Detail page for "/property/corporate-plaza-c-scheme-2" rendered with enquiry actions

results.name: Category tab filters the listing grid
results.expected: Selecting Commercial re-queries the API
results.actual: Category tab correctly re-queried the API with category=Commercial

results.name: Locality filter applies every ticked locality
results.expected: All selected localities reach the API
results.actual: Ticked 3 localities (Sitapura, Jagatpura, Mansarovar) but the API request contained only locality="Sitapura". The remaining selections are discarded with no message to the user.

results.name: Expert Experience filter narrows results
results.expected: Selecting 15+ Years changes the expert grid
results.actual: With the Domain filter held constant, selecting "15+ Years" left the grid unchanged at 1 experts (baseline 1). The control is inert.

results.name: Expert Location filter narrows results
results.expected: Ticking a location changes the expert grid
results.actual: Ticking "Mansarovar" left the grid unchanged at 1 experts (baseline 1). The control is inert.

results.name: Login rejects a short phone number
results.expected: Submit stays disabled until 10 digits are entered
results.actual: Submit correctly disabled for a 3-digit number

results.name: Lead API rejects malformed payloads
results.expected: POST /api/leads returns 422 for bad data
results.actual: HTTP 422 - {"ok":false,"error":"Validation failed","issues":{"name":["Name is required"],"phone":["Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number"]}}

results.name: Login screen offers the documented OTP flow
results.expected: OTP entry exists as described in the transfer document
results.actual: No OTP exists on the login screen; it asks for phone + password. The transfer document describes an OTP flow that is not present in this build.

results.name: Documented admin number 9990001111 can log in
results.expected: Admin credentials from the transfer document work
results.actual: Rejected with "Invalid phone number or password". This account has no stored password (created under the removed OTP flow), so no password can ever authenticate it.

results.name: Password recovery is available
results.expected: A forgot-password option exists
results.actual: No forgot/reset password option. The one-time temporary password is never re-sent, so losing it locks the account out permanently.

results.name: Guest can submit a property enquiry end to end
results.expected: Enquiry submits and returns a reference number
results.actual: Enquiry accepted, reference MWC-2026-10820 issued and shown to the user

results.name: Guest can submit a property listing end to end
results.expected: Wizard completes and issues account credentials
results.actual: BLOCKER: a guest cannot complete the listing wizard. Step 2 requires a photo before "Continue" becomes active (Continue disabled: true), but POST /api/upload returns 401 because it calls requireUser(). The page shows "Authentication required". Since /list-property is the only route that creates an account, no new user can register through the website at all.

results.name: New listing is withheld from public search until approved
results.expected: Pending listing does not appear in public results
results.actual: Pending listing correctly hidden from public search until an admin approves it

results.name: Owner dashboard shows the new listing with pending status
results.expected: Listing appears with a Pending badge
results.actual: Listing visible on the dashboard with status pending: true

results.name: Temporary-password warning is shown to the owner
results.expected: Dashboard prompts the user to set a real password
results.actual: Dashboard displays the temporary-password notice with a change form

results.name: Logged-in user can save a property and see it in Saved
results.expected: Heart toggle persists to the Saved page
results.actual: Saved page reports 1 saved property/properties after the heart toggle

results.name: Non-admin owner is blocked from the admin console
results.expected: Owner session cannot open /admin
results.actual: Owner session correctly refused access to the admin console

results.name: Owner can log out and log back in with the issued password
results.expected: Round-trip login works
results.actual: Logged out and back in successfully with the issued temporary password; landed on /dashboard

results.name: Every public page has a unique title and meta description
results.expected: Distinct title + description per page
results.actual: All 7 pages have unique titles and descriptions

results.name: robots.txt and sitemap.xml are served
results.expected: Both reachable with valid content
results.actual: robots.txt HTTP 200 (has Disallow rules: true), sitemap.xml HTTP 200 with 22 URLs

results.name: Images are optimized
results.expected: Images served through next/image with lazy loading
results.actual: 13 images on the page; 0 optimized via next/image and 0 lazy-loaded. All use raw tags pointing at full-size originals, so no resizing, WebP conversion or lazy loading is applied.

results.name: Images have alt text and pages have one H1
results.expected: No empty alt attributes; exactly one H1 per page
results.actual: /: 4/19 images missing alt; /find-property: 0 H1 headings

results.name: No horizontal overflow on a 390px mobile viewport
results.expected: Pages fit the viewport width
results.actual: No horizontal overflow on any page tested

results.name: No unexpected console or network errors
results.expected: Clean console across the session
results.actual: Unexpected failing requests: 404 /favicon.ico, 401 /api/upload
